mapper.sql: r.region_id as segmId, r.super_region_id as parentSegmId, r.region_name as segmName, r.region_name as standName, r.region_no as segmNo, case when r.super_region_id is null or r.super_region_id = '' then '180000' else '180001' end as segmType, case when r.super_region_id is null or r.super_region_id = '' then 1 else 2 end as addrLevel, r.region_id as regionId, r.notes as notes

choose.when: and r.super_region_id is not null and r.super_region_id != ''
and r.super_region_id is not null and r.super_region_id != ''

mapper.select:
select
from spc_region r where r.region_id = #{regionId} and coalesce(r.delete_state, '0') = '0'
select * from spc_region where coalesce(delete_state, '0') = '0' and region_name = #{regionName}

select
from spc_region r
coalesce(r.delete_state, '0') = '0'
and (r.super_region_id is null or r.super_region_id = '')
and r.super_region_id is not null and r.super_region_id != ''
and r.region_name like #{keywordLike}
order by r.region_no
